concepts.label: XDCR Replication status enum
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused, WITH A THIRD-VOCABULARY FINDING - minted in cloud/clusters/xdcr/manage-xdcr-replications.json with values Creating/Active/Pausing/Paused/Deleting/Create Error/Delete Error. This page's own status words are 'replicating' (Web Console UI, lowercase), 'paused' (CLI --list output), and 'running'/'notRunning' (REST /pools/default/tasks). None of 'replicating', 'running', or 'notRunning' appears in the Capella enum at all, and Capella's 'Active' never appears here - a same-mechanism, three-vocabulary split (Capella UI-label case / Server UI-label case / Server REST-layer case) discovered exactly by the side-by-side reading this batch's brief calls for. Deliberately NOT related via renamedFrom: that predicate is for a naming-history fact over time, and this is a simultaneous cross-layer/cross-product spelling difference with no page stating either supersedes the other - recorded here in prose rather than forced onto an ill-fitting predicate.

cross_component_finding: THE THREE-VOCABULARY STATUS SPLIT IS THIS BATCH'S CLEAREST ANALOGUE TO ROUND 20'S xdcr:conflict-resolution-method NAMING-INCONSISTENCY FINDING. Round 20 found the SAME enum named two ways across two reference pages; this batch finds the SAME lifecycle state (replication is currently running/replicating/not-paused) named THREE ways across Capella's UI ('Active'), Server's UI ('replicating'), and Server's own REST layer ('running'/'notRunning') - none of them sharing a spelling, and no page in the corpus reconciling any two of the three. The registry's xdcr:replication-status-enum concept as it stands only documents the Capella vocabulary; this record supplies the missing Server-side value set for reconciliation to fold in or keep separate.
